## `users list`

Retrieves the list of Users with pagination (sorting and filtering)

```
epm-cli users list [flags]
```

API: `GET /v3/Users` · Response: `V3UserListItemModelPagedResponse`

**Filters and parameters**

| Flag | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sort FIELD[:asc\|desc]` | repeatable | | sort order, e.g. `--sort created:desc` |
| `--page-size` | integer |  | The number of records per page, for example 1. Shouldn't exceed 200. |
| `--page` | integer |  | The page number to retrieve from results, for example 1 |
| `--email-address` | string |  | User email address |
| `--role-id` | UUID |  | Unique identifier of the GlobalRole |
| `--permission-id` | UUID |  | Unique Identifier of the Permission |
| `--last-signed-in-dates` | list of date-time |  | Valid date formats for filter - 2020-12-24, 2020-12-24 19:09:47, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562 +00:00 |
| `--last-signed-in-selection-mode` | string | `Single`, `Multiple`, `Range` | The selection mode of date criteria e.g single, multiple, range |
| `--disabled` | switch |  | Is user disabled |
| `--language` | string |  | Language |
| `--all`, `-A` | switch | | fetch every page |
| `--max-pages` | integer | | with `--all`: stop after N pages |

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli users list --all -o json
```

## `users create`

Creates user and assigns customized permissions or roles.

```
epm-cli users create [flags]
```

API: `POST /v3/Users`

**Request body** (JSON, `V3CreateUserRequest`)

| Flag | Field | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--email-address` | `emailAddress` | string |  | EmailAddress |
| `--olson-time-zone-id` | `olsonTimeZoneId` | string |  | OlsonTimeZoneId |
| `--date-time-display-format` | `dateTimeDisplayFormat` | string |  | DateTimeDisplayFormat |
| `--language` | `language` | string |  | Language |
| `--enabled` | `enabled` | switch |  | Enabled |
| `--admin` | `admin` | switch |  | admin |
| `--all-groups` | `allGroups` | switch |  | full permissions for all groups |
| `--group-roles` | `groupRoles` | list of UUID |  | roles to assign all groups |
| `--all-policies` | `allPolicies` | switch |  | full permissions for all policies |
| `--policy-roles` | `policyRoles` | list of UUID |  | role to assign all policies |
| `--global-roles-ids` | `globalRolesIds` | list of UUID |  | The list of System.Guid mentioning which global roles the user needs to have |

Other or nested fields: `--set path=value`, or pass the whole body with `--body` (inline, `@file.json` or `-` for stdin). Example body (`--body-template`):

```json
{
  "emailAddress": "",
  "olsonTimeZoneId": "",
  "dateTimeDisplayFormat": "",
  "language": "",
  "enabled": false,
  "roleResource": [
    {
      "resourceType": "",
      "resourceId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "roleId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
    }
  ],
  "admin": false,
  "allGroups": false,
  "groupRoles": [
    "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  ],
  "allPolicies": false,
  "policyRoles": [
    "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  ],
  "globalRolesIds": [
    "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  ]
}
```

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli users create --email-address <VALUE>
```

## `users disable`
